entries.message: Choosing a crest, symbol or emoji as a Space's icon keeps the Space's colors.
A Space's appearance starts with templates, each a full set of icon and colors, then the colors and the icon to refine it, with Undo when a template replaces colors you chose.
Give any Space color an exact hex code, or pick it with the system color picker.
More Customization for a Space opens as its own page, with the crest's colors at the top.
